Scope: Static product-page, installer metadata, licensing and data-effect review of MiTeC InfoBar 4.6.2; installer payload not extracted or executed

ProductPage.PublishedBehavior: Taskbar-like auto-hide panel with system uptime, power, disk, network, CPU/process/memory and keyboard-lock information; embedded desktop explorer, calendar, calculator, coding tools, notepad, weather/forecast, RSS reader, system/process monitors and network-interface list. The publisher history mentions delayed logon startup, an OpenWeather Map API key, RSS/Atom support, selected weather location, network access detection and Explorer-crash recovery. Exact network traffic, startup writes, data retention and recovery behavior are not established by the page.
ProductPage.OperatingSystems: Publisher lists Windows Vista-11 and Windows Server 2008-2025; this is not RIDE target acceptance.
ProductPage.LicenseObservation: The product page says freeware for private, educational and non-commercial purposes.

TermsPage.Observation: The current support EULA separately describes non-commercial freeware and named-user/build-machine, team, site and trial licensing. Local intended-use rights and redistribution remain unresolved.

PinnedInstaller.PreviousBoundedListing: PE installer with 18 listed entries; inner payload and actions remain unknown because extraction/execution was out of scope.

ReviewFindings: The publisher page and frozen installer/page pins match the inventory, but the executable installer exposes no established application file/version inventory in this review. Product version 4.6.2 is the publisher-page version and installer ProductVersion metadata, not verified installed application behavior.

The feature set spans host monitoring, process/network views, RSS/weather services, a location preference, and coding tools. Treat process names, interface details, location, RSS content and any credentials as potentially sensitive; do not configure real feeds, API keys or locations in acceptance.

Delayed logon startup and Explorer-crash recovery are version-history statements, not verified registry/task actions or recovery guarantees. Exact installer scope, startup integration, cleanup, internet requests and component notices remain unknown.

MigrationDisposition.Resolved: Publisher-described features, page version, noncommercial terms and pinned installer metadata are recorded.
MigrationDisposition.Partial: Installer scope, startup/recovery behavior, local entitlement, component notices, network requests, host-data handling, UI and activation remain unverified.
Deferred: Owner-specific MiTeC use and installer redistribution assessment
Review installer actions and exact component notices from a safely retained source before proposing activation
Any later acceptance needs an isolated guest, synthetic host data, no real RSS/weather credentials/location, and exact startup/removal recovery checks
MigrationDisposition.EstimateReason: The public feature surface and installer metadata are clearer, but the installer actions and complete user-visible/runtime outcome remain unknown; no estimate deduction is justified.
